	cargo build

	cargo fmt --check

clippy:
	cargo clippy -- -D warnings

clean:
	cargo clean

- **`make fmt`** — auto-format code with `cargo fmt`
- **`make clean`** — remove build artifacts via `cargo clean`
- **`make`** / **`make all`** — defaults to `build`
